66094.meaning1: mass of properties; hoard of land

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, udāyi, gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, nekānaṃ nikkhagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ dhaññagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ khettagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ vatthugaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ bhariyagaṇānaṃ cayo

66097.commentary: (VINt) saha vatthu'jjhācārā'ti vatthuvītikkamena saha. sahayoge karaṇavacanappasaṅge idaṃ nissakkavacanaṃ.

examples.text: vatthu nāma ārāmavatthu vihāravatthu. vatthuṭṭhaṃ nāma bhaṇḍaṃ vatthusmiṃ catūhi ṭhānehi nikkhittaṃ hoti, bhūmaṭṭhaṃ, thalaṭṭhaṃ, ākāsaṭṭhaṃ, vehāsaṭṭhaṃ.

66099.meaning2: triple gem (the Buddha, the Dhamma and the Saṅgha); lit. three things

examples.text: titthiyo hi vattaṃ pūrayamāno titthiyānaṃ vaṇṇe bhaññamāne kuddho ārādhako hoti, vatthuttayassa vaṇṇe bhaññamāne kuddho gārayho hotī'ti tatth'ev'assā vitthāro vutto.
